_note: STARTING POINT — curated by ClauseWise maintainers. Review and extend before each release. Not legal advice; used only for severity comparison within the tool.

typical_patterns.typical: Data shared only with service providers necessary for delivery of the service, not sold to third parties for advertising.
red_flags: user data sold to third parties
data shared with unnamed affiliates
consent obtained once and applied to future unrelated uses
no opt-out for marketing

typical_patterns.typical: Users retain the right to go to small claims court. Class actions permitted or waiver is narrow and disclosed prominently.
red_flags: mandatory binding arbitration for all disputes
class action waiver hidden in fine print
arbitration costs borne by user
user waives right to jury trial

typical_patterns.typical: Renewal disclosed clearly, reminder sent before charge, cancellation easy (as easy as sign-up).
red_flags: auto-renewal with no advance notice
cancellation requires phone call or written letter only
renewal at higher price with no notice
no pro-rata refund on cancellation

typical_patterns.typical: Liability capped at amount paid in last 12 months. Platform not liable for indirect/consequential loss.
red_flags: all liability disclaimed including for gross negligence
cap is zero or a nominal amount
platform can change service without notice and bear no liability
death and personal injury not excluded from disclaimer

typical_patterns.typical: User grants platform a limited license to host and display user content. User retains ownership.
red_flags: perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use content for any purpose
platform can sub-license content
platform owns derivative works
no right to delete and revoke license

typical_patterns.typical: Changes notified at least 30 days in advance. User can reject changes by cancelling the service.
red_flags: terms can change at any time without notice
continued use after posting constitutes acceptance
changes retroactively apply to prior use
no right to object or cancel without penalty

typical_patterns.typical: Platform may suspend for breach of ToS. User notified with opportunity to appeal. Data exportable before deletion.
red_flags: platform may terminate for any reason without notice
no appeal process
user data deleted immediately with no export window
no pro-rata refund on termination
